description.value:
You pick up a set of distracting tricks: whenever you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can give up two of the Sneak Attack dice to instead pull off one of the following maneuvers. Several of them force the target to resist with a saving throw, using a DC equal to 8 plus your proficiency bonus plus your Dexterity modifier.

Hinder. The target attempts a Constitution save. On a failure, it picks up one level of slowed until the end of its next turn, and the next Dexterity save it attempts before then is made with disadvantage.

Pilfer. The target attempts a Wisdom save. On a failure, you gain advantage on the next Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check you make against it before the end of your following turn.

Tumble. You dart 10 feet in any direction you like, and the target attempts a Dexterity save. On a failure, that dash does not trigger an opportunity attack from it.
